## Design

### 2026-10-06 – 17:00

**3h**

17:00

I'm trying to get KiCad to work, it's crashing as i launch the schematic editor, but i will try to figure out why it's doing that.

17:37
I am working on the starbie right now as im writing this, I’m actually having fun designing the PCB, I’ve had some technical problems so it took me like 20 minutes to get KiCad running. Compiling it from the AUR just isn’t it, I couldn’t open the schematic editor so I had to use the AppImage version instead, which did not have the symbols already installed so then I had to extract the AppImage and get the symbols from there. I am having so much fun.

I’m adding labels right now, stuff like DHT11 Data and etc. I am following the guide so it is kind of just handed to me but it does give a good example of how designing PCB’s is.

### 2026-10-07 – 07/10/2026

**2h**

07/10/2026
16:00

I had another issue where my 01x04 pin didn’t match my schematic, so I checked around and ended up deleting it to then update the PCB. With that, I can finally route my Starbie. The main issue was that the naming confused me ALOT, where GND was labelled as SDA, essentially just swapping places.
(GND – SDA, +3.3V – SCL, and opposite) So that was really weird.

Redid the GND pour filling just in case, im finally ready to move on to the next step!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/csmENG14rakT3PR8mx3XRX637rr9SdHI/5e68a07e27af3daa46756abcb89870cbfc93c4045a75081a6b2add12e477e6f1.png)

16:31
Actually… I cleaned it up more sooo… BUT it should be better now.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/csmENG14rakT3PR8mx3XRX637rr9SdHI/1b8d0adbbf2993e6ba0acc5e190b64ced4f0f667f971dec727f420f1f7da130f.png)

16:51
Im adding a few easter eggs to my Starbie, im going to add Mizuki and Ena from Hatsune Miku: Colorful stage, Quaver and beat from UNBEATABLE and lastly Lacie from Paper Lily.

17:29

Ok, I might’ve gotten a bit carried away, but it’s just fun to customize my Starbie however I like. So that’s 30 minutes… Anyways I added Quaver (UNBEATABLE), Basil (Omori), Neo Universe (Umamusume), Oguri Cap (Umamusume), Aoi (Paper Lily), Lacie (Paper Lily) and Ena (Hatsune Miku: Colorful Stage). This stuff takes some time huh… Well either way its time for the firmware!
